reviewedArticles.referenceEvidence: Original hands-on links manufacturer m79250ba-0001; current exact manufacturer page confirms slate-grey 43 mm bronze, black leather and MT5601. Actual closed back is engraved MT5601. Separate fabric variant is documented in the loan review; caseback remains specimen-specific and no opened MT5601 image is available.

Photographed steel/gold source explicitly identifies 79733N, but stored 79733 is incomplete and no documented alias is established. Isolated MT5612 media has unconfirmed photograph provenance. No attachment to incomplete key.
Actual Black Bay Dark 79230DK is separately identified, not an alias of 79230R/B/N. No attachment to joined stored key or neighbouring steel models.

note: Every main article image was decoded and visually inspected, including embedded tiled galleries and off-model comparisons. Duplicate article/gallery appearances count as image occurrences, not unique media. Related-post thumbnails and avatars excluded. Unsupported movements and year-coded aliases withheld.
